10001.story: As of Oct 12, the record for Kent County runs from 1951 to 2025, and on the middle value of the county's 8 grids September to October came in under 90% of normal in 37 of 75 years. In 2026 so far, the middle of the grids sat at 49% of normal for February to March and 52% for March to April. Every grid had its driest year in 1965, and grid 23319 got 54% of normal that year.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ

10003.story: As of Oct 12, the middle value of the county's 8 grids in New Castle County came in under 90% of normal in 37 of 75 years for both August to September and September to October. In 2025, the middle of the grids ran 51% of normal in August to September and 52% in January to February. So far in 2026 it shows 61% in February to March. Every grid had its driest year in 1965, with grid 23318 at 58% of normal that year.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ

10005.story: As of Oct 12, the middle value of the county's 9 grids in Sussex County came in under 90% of normal in September to October in 37 of 75 years since 1951. In 2025 that middle fell to 60% of normal in August to September and 51% in November to December. So far in 2026 it shows 46% for March to April and 47% for April to May. Grid 22420 had its driest year in 1968 at 65% of normal.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ
